look_brief: LA-2A-style opto leveler; our own name and wordmark (ADR 0004).

Panel: light grey matte powder coat (#c4c6c4), 3U with rack ears; two large black-headed rack screws per ear, small panel screws along the bottom and in the corners, a piano hinge along the bottom edge.

Gain and Peak Reduction: glossy black bakelite, round cap on a teardrop pointer skirt, white line on the cap and the skirt tip (knob style pointer_skirt). Numbers 0-100 in steps of 10 printed in an arc around each, no ticks.
Meter selector: the same knob family, three positions (Gain Reduction, Output +10, Output +4).
VU meter: dark grey bevelled bezel, cream face, black scale with a red +1..+3 section, 'VU' at both ends, inner 0-100 scale.
Switches: chrome bat toggles with hex nuts (Limit/Compress, Power). Red jewel pilot lamp as on the 1960s original.
Original branding to replace: red italic wordmark with a double-line swoosh, and the manufacturer logo above the meter. Ours: a red wordmark, no swoosh, no logo.
Wear: light vintage (0.3). Labels: small plain sans-serif capitals.
